scope: UnityPy 1.25.4 with TypeTreeGeneratorAPI 0.0.10; original Unity Mono 2018.2.20f1

findings.issue: AssetsTools generated MonoBehaviour m_Enabled lacks alignment; m_Script reads byte-shifted yet total byte-size may still pass
findings.remedy: Replace only the four engine header nodes with version-matched UnityPy TPK MonoBehaviour header, preserving custom layout; check pointer resolution as well as byte consumption.

findings.issue: UnityScript assemblies have module names without .dll and AssetsTools backend fails its lookup
findings.remedy: Use loaded module names and AssetRipper backend for the affected UnityScript classes; keep backend-specific failures explicit.

findings.issue: Generated string[] wrapper may be called string although its Array.data child is string; fast parser treats array bytes as one string
findings.remedy: After confirming managed field is string[], rebuild wrapper as vector with same child nodes. Construct fresh TypeTreeNodes because mutating m_Type leaves C parser cached behavior unchanged.

findings.issue: Raw type-tree API can replace Unicode managed field names with question marks (Cyrillic U+0421 in TRAFFIC_MANAGER field)
findings.remedy: Prefer get_nodes_as_json and JSON decoding to preserve Unicode field names; validate exact field identity against original metadata/export.

bounds: These checks close source decoding coverage only; do not prove exported serialized values or runtime fidelity. No installed tools were patched. Original managed layouts and raw objects remain preserved.
